summary: Backend data model for SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL. Three new FunnelStep fields (targetFunnelId, targetEntryStepId, endParentAfter) plus enum constant, DTO mirror, toSteps/toStepDto mapping, and TODO-marked temporary branches in the two exhaustive switches. The change is a faithful mirror of the existing eventName pattern and matches tech-spec Data Models exactly.
positive_notes: targetEntryStepId named correctly (NOT targetStepId) per Decision 5; avoids Button.targetStepId collision and is excluded from the generic edge-pass (requireExistingTarget only reads getNext()/getTimeoutTargetStepId()), so no false funnel_broken_edge.
endParentAfter is a primitive boolean (default false), mapped directly via dto.endParentAfter() without blankToNull — matches edge-case requirement.
String fields mapped via blankToNull, mirroring eventName.
copyOf copies all three fields field-wise (Strings by reference, boolean by value); javadoc deep-copy contract updated, snapshot isolation (Decision 3) preserved.
FunnelStepDto constructor arg order in toStepDto matches record component order; the existing FunnelServiceEmitEventTest constructor was correctly updated with the three trailing args.
isMessageStep unchanged, so SUBSCRIBE_TO_FUNNEL correctly falls through to the non_message preview placeholder.
Temporary switch branches in StepExecutor.execute and FunnelService.validateSteps are clearly TODO-marked for Task 3 / Task 2, no premature logic and no new injected dependencies.
